title: Taco's Tweaks
description: very slight tweaks to vanilla textures for PvP
body:
Some very simple tweaks to a few vanilla textures meant for PvP
Currently, changes have been made to the following textures:

- End Crystals
- Bedrock
- Obsidian

To use, simply put the ZIP file into your resource packs folder and load it from the resource packs menu in-game.
